description: Per-node health, load, VRAM, RAM, GPU util, and routing. Grafana uses router /metrics for fleet telemetry (RAM, GPU util, known-vs-zero VRAM). Local compose may also scrape mock node-agent :11436 for ollama_up; do not add production :11436 scrape jobs. Duration histogram is class-only (not per-node). Do not query by model name. vram_free_gb=0 is empty only when vram_free_known=1. VRAM ledger / placement (reserved, loaded, used, free, total) is collapsed by default.

targets.expr: sum by (code) (rate(ollama_router_requests_total{node="-", class=~"$class"}[5m]))
ollama_router_node_vram_gb and on(node) ollama_router_node_info{node=~"$node", origin=~"$origin", role=~"$role"}
(ollama_router_node_vram_free_gb * on(node) (ollama_router_node_vram_free_known == 1)) and on(node) ollama_router_node_info{node=~"$node", origin=~"$origin", role=~"$role"}

panels.title: VRAM GiB (total and free)
panels.description: GiB = bytes/1024³. Unit is none (not SI GB). CPU nodes often have vram_gb=0. Free is plotted only when vram_free_known=1: 0 then means an empty GPU. When known=0, free is omitted (unknown, not empty).

targets.expr: ollama_router_node_pressure and on(node) ollama_router_node_info{node=~"$node", origin=~"$origin", role=~"$role"}

panels.title: Pressure (0 unknown / 1 ok / 2 elevated / 3 critical)
panels.description: PressureLevel from the node agent; router does not reclassify. Elevated: score +2, inflight cap −1 (floor 1) unless explicit max. Critical: score +8, inflight cap 1; hard-reject when reject_on_ram_critical. Meaningful on CPU nodes even when VRAM is 0.

targets.expr: ((ollama_router_node_vram_gb > 0) * (ollama_router_node_vram_free_known == 1) * (ollama_router_node_vram_free_gb / clamp_min(ollama_router_node_vram_gb, 1e-9))) and on(node) ollama_router_node_info{node=~"$node", origin=~"$origin", role=~"$role"}

panels.title: VRAM free ratio (hidden when vram_gb=0 or free unknown)
panels.description: Hidden for CPU/Metal without discrete VRAM (known=0) and when vram_gb=0. A full GPU (free=0, known=1) shows ratio 0.

targets.expr: ((ollama_router_node_vram_free_known == 1) * (ollama_router_node_vram_gb - ollama_router_node_vram_free_gb)) and on(node) ollama_router_node_info{node=~"$node", origin=~"$origin", role=~"$role"}

panels.title: Estimated VRAM used GiB (total − free, not the ledger)
panels.description: Estimate = total − free, gated on vram_free_known=1 (full GPU shows used=total). This is not reserved (ledger), loaded (/api/ps), or agent-reported used. See the VRAM ledger / placement row for those series. GiB = bytes/1024³.

targets.expr: ollama_router_node_reserved_vram_gb and on(node) ollama_router_node_info{node=~"$node", origin=~"$origin", role=~"$role"}

panels.title: Reserved VRAM GiB (ledger)
panels.description: GiB = bytes/1024³. Reservation ledger (inflight admission holds), not /api/ps loaded and not agent used. 0 is an empty ledger, not unknown.

targets.expr: (ollama_router_node_loaded_vram_gb * on(node) (ollama_router_node_loaded_vram_known == 1)) and on(node) ollama_router_node_info{node=~"$node", origin=~"$origin", role=~"$role"}

panels.title: Loaded VRAM GiB (/api/ps, known only)
panels.description: GiB = bytes/1024³. Loaded is /api/ps merge. Plotted only when loaded_vram_known=1; omitted when unknown (not a zero load).

targets.expr: (ollama_router_node_vram_used_gb * on(node) (ollama_router_node_vram_used_known == 1)) and on(node) ollama_router_node_info{node=~"$node", origin=~"$origin", role=~"$role"}

panels.title: Used VRAM GiB (agent, known only)
panels.description: GiB = bytes/1024³. Agent-reported used VRAM. Plotted only when vram_used_known=1; omitted when unknown (not empty).

targets.expr: (ollama_router_node_vram_free_gb * on(node) (ollama_router_node_vram_free_known == 1)) and on(node) ollama_router_node_info{node=~"$node", origin=~"$origin", role=~"$role"}

panels.title: Free VRAM GiB (agent, known only)
panels.description: GiB = bytes/1024³. Agent-reported free VRAM. Plotted only when vram_free_known=1: 0 then means a full GPU, not unknown. When known=0, the series is omitted.

targets.expr: ollama_router_node_vram_gb and on(node) ollama_router_node_info{node=~"$node", origin=~"$origin", role=~"$role"}

panels.title: Total VRAM GiB
panels.description: GiB = bytes/1024³. Effective VRAM capacity per node (router re-export). CPU/Metal without discrete inventory is often 0.

targets.expr: ollama_router_node_ram_available_gb and on(node) ollama_router_node_info{node=~"$node", origin=~"$origin", role=~"$role"}

panels.title: RAM available GiB
panels.description: Gate on ram_available_known=1 in Explore if a node shows 0 before the first capacity probe.

targets.expr: ollama_router_node_ram_available_ratio and on(node) ollama_router_node_info{node=~"$node", origin=~"$origin", role=~"$role"}
(ollama_router_node_cpu_usage_pct * on(node) (ollama_router_node_cpu_usage_known == 1)) and on(node) ollama_router_node_info{node=~"$node", origin=~"$origin", role=~"$role"}
ollama_router_node_disk_available_gb and on(node) ollama_router_node_info{node=~"$node", origin=~"$origin", role=~"$role"}
ollama_router_node_fail_streak and on(node) ollama_router_node_info{node=~"$node", origin=~"$origin", role=~"$role"}
ollama_router_node_draining and on(node) ollama_router_node_info{node=~"$node", origin=~"$origin", role=~"$role"}
ollama_router_node_max_inflight and on(node) ollama_router_node_info{node=~"$node", origin=~"$origin", role=~"$role"}
(ollama_router_node_gpu_utilization_pct * on(node) (ollama_router_node_gpu_util_known == 1)) and on(node) ollama_router_node_info{node=~"$node", origin=~"$origin", role=~"$role"}

panels.title: GPU utilization % (known only)
panels.description: Hidden when gpu_util_known=0 (CPU / Metal without discrete NVIDIA).

targets.expr: (ollama_router_node_vram_free_gb * on(node) (ollama_router_node_vram_free_known == 1)) and on(node) ollama_router_node_info{node=~"$node", origin=~"$origin", role=~"$role"}

panels.title: VRAM free GiB (known only)
panels.description: Full GPU shows 0. CPU/Metal without discrete VRAM is hidden.

targets.expr: ollama_router_node_gpu_vram_gb and on(node) ollama_router_node_info{node=~"$node", origin=~"$origin", role=~"$role"}
(ollama_router_node_gpu_vram_free_gb * on(node,gpu) (ollama_router_node_gpu_vram_free_known == 1)) and on(node) ollama_router_node_info{node=~"$node", origin=~"$origin", role=~"$role"}
ollama_router_node_gpu_temperature_c and on(node) ollama_router_node_info{node=~"$node", origin=~"$origin", role=~"$role"}
